blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania offers is a long-held dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb of Kilimanjaro or lazy days on Zanzibar’s paradise beaches, Tanzania covers it all. The good news: Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that meets all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For ideas, take a look at our most popular itineraries. Many of our clients like to round off an exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or have your journey tailored to you; either way, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just as you want it!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you on arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing and advises you on clothing, packing and other useful tips so that your climb is as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: Your guide picks you up in the morning and takes you on an approximately 4-hour drive to the Londorossi Gate, the west entrance of Kilimanjaro National Park. The road leads through a beautiful tropical rainforest. You arrive at the drop-off point at 3,500 meters where you can enjoy an amazing view of the Shira plateau for the first time. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature and acclimatize to the high altitude while you prepare for an exciting adventure.
blocks.html: In the morning your guide collects you for a drive of about 4 hours to the Londorossi Gate, the western entrance to Kilimanjaro National Park. The road winds through a beautiful tropical rainforest. At the drop-off point, at 3,500 meters, you get your first wonderful view of the Shira plateau. Take in the natural beauty and get used to the high altitude as you get ready for an exciting adventure.

blocks.orig: On this second day on the mountain, the Lemosho route joins the Machame route. The hike leads from Shira 2 Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). This part of the climb has many ascents and descents but offers beautiful views along the way. It is a long hike and you may start to feel a bit uncomfortable because of the height. It is therefore important to find the right pace for your body to adjust to the altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp at the foot of Barranco Wall.
blocks.html: On your second day on the mountain, the Lemosho route meets the Machame route. You walk from Shira 2 Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft). There are many ups and downs on this section, but the views along the way are lovely. It is a long day, and the altitude may begin to make you feel slightly uncomfortable, so finding a pace that lets your body adapt to the height is important. After lunch you head down to Barranco Camp, at the foot of the Barranco Wall.

blocks.orig: For many people, this is their favourite part of the climb: going from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. Once there, you have a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Many climbers name this as their favourite stretch: the climb from Barranco Camp up the Barranco Wall. At the top you are rewarded with a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.

blocks.orig: Afterwards, a more difficult hike starts to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest, you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: After that comes a tougher hike to Karanga Camp. The trail goes up and down a lot, so keep to a steady pace. Lunch is served at the camp, and once you have rested you can do an acclimatisation hike towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: After breakfast the hike to Barafu Camp starts. This is the starting point for your ascent to the Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: Following breakfast you set off for Barafu Camp, the base for your ascent of Uhuru Peak, the summit of Kilimanjaro! You reach the camp at about lunchtime. Rest for a while and, once you feel stronger, do an acclimatisation hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Take in the breathtaking views of the peaks around you and enjoy the thrill of camping at high altitude as you get ready for the final summit push at around midnight.

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit, you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a short time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph, you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: This is the big day! At around midnight you leave Barafu Camp for Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the toughest part is the high altitude. When you reach the top, a beautiful sunrise awaits, which is really impressive at this height! You spend a short while on the summit celebrating your ultimate triumph, then make your way slowly down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millenium Camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: Millenium Camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up this morning, you feel relief at the lower altitude and satisfaction at having reached the summit. After breakfast an easy walk takes you to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: From there your driver takes you back to the hotel for a well-earned rest!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not ready for it to end? You can also extend your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
